text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: AUTH_SIGN_VERIFY_FAILS (PDT-4491) — 5xx/401 spike on /api/v1/auth/validate across us-west-2, page to oncall

pagerduty: Incident P-4491 created, page fired to maya (oncall). Escalation policy: auth-service -> platform -> sre-leads.

maya (oncall): ack — picking this up. seeing alert flood in the dashboard, thanks for the page. anyone already looking at logs?

jordan: I see a sudden jump in 401s starting ~10:03 UTC. matching client errors across multiple tenants. traces show jwt validation failing with `kid not found` from our JWKS fetch.

lee (auth-service): unpaused key rotation earlier this morning at 02:00 local. jwks endpoint returned new set, but signing service still using old key id for issued tokens. suspect mismatch between signing and the rotation job.

sam (platform): are we sure it's a rotation prop issue and not JWKS cache TTL? edge caches might still have stale keys, but `kid not found` suggests signing produced tokens with unknown kid or clients use tokens with kid not in jwks.

rachel (product): customer success already pulled in a couple of tickets — some enterprise customers reporting immediate 401s on session refresh. Need impact summary for exec ASAP.

maya (oncall): ok, immediate mitigation: roll back rotation (re-enable old JWKS entry / revert rotation flag) and force JWKS cache refresh across edge nodes. Lee, can auth-service re-swap to old signing key?

lee (auth-service): initiating rollback of rotation flag. running: `./manage-keys rollback --to=key-2026-02-old`

lee (auth-service): also starting on a forced JWKS publish: POST /internal/jwks/publish -> status 202.

pagerduty: maya (oncall) acknowledged the incident (P-4491) at 10:09 UTC. Next escalation in 12m if not resolved.

sam (platform): I'm running a JWKS cache invalidation across CDN and api-gateway:
```
for node in $(list-gateway-nodes); do
  ssh $node "curl -X POST https://localhost:9100/cache/invalidate?target=jwks"
done
```

sam (platform): invalidation jobs queued. hitting nodes now.

ops-shift: pushed a config to increase auth-service logging for `token.verify` to debug for 30m.

jordan: quick check — the signing-service logs show tokens being issued with `kid: key-2026-02-new` at 10:02:48, but JWKS produced by key manager didn't include `key-2026-02-new` until 10:03:55. 1m+ gap where newly minted tokens couldn't be validated.

maya (oncall): that gap explains the sudden 401 spike. timeline so far: rotation unpause -> signing starts using new kid -> jwks propagation delayed -> validation fails.

lee (auth-service): rollback completed. signing-service switched back to `key-2026-02-old` at 10:12:03. publishing old key to JWKS and forcing cache refresh.

sam (platform): CDN/gateway cache invalidation finished. pulling metrics now.

jordan: error rate dropping — 401s fell to baseline at 10:14:40. looks like mitigation is working.

rachel (product): collecting impacted customer list from CS: ~8 customers reported failures (2 enterprise, 6 SMB). impact window estimated ~10:02–10:14 UTC. patch notes and customer comms need to go out.

maya (oncall): good. next: post-incident actions. Lee, please open a follow-up ticket for the key rotation choreography: ensure atomic swap between signing-service and jwks publish, add pre-checks. Sam, add monitoring for jwks mismatch and end-to-end validation test.

lee (auth-service): filed AUTH-1729: "Key rotation: ensure publish-before-sign or delayed-sign until JWKS propagation confirmed". added acceptance test to rotation pipeline.

sam (platform): filed PLAT-884: "Automate JWKS cache refresh across gateways + add SLO alert when jwks kid mismatch detected".

rachel (product): drafting customer communication. will include timeline, root cause, and remediation. will share for review in #customer-success.

security-bot: Notified security on-call. Flagged for potential audit but initial assessment: internal key rotation workflow issue, no sign of key compromise.

maya (oncall): handing off to ops-shift for follow-through. I'm off rotation in 20m — leaving the thread to ops-shift. If anything regresses, ping me.

ops-shift: taking over. confirm we have runbook steps updated and follow-ups assigned. I'll own the bridge for postmortem.

pagerduty: P-4491 resolved by maya (oncall) at 10:18 UTC. Incident status: mitigated.

maya (oncall): closing notes: mitigation worked, rollback safe. action items: AUTH-1729, PLAT-884, add a synthetic test that requests a token then validates against JWKS before enabling rotation. assign owners and deadlines in the tickets. :thumbsup:

ops-shift: will schedule the postmortem and invite auth-service, platform, product, and security.

rachel (product): confirmed customer comms queued — ETA 30m.

jordan: adding logs and traces to the incident timeline in the ticket. saving key excerpts:
```
- 10:02:48 signing-service issued token with kid=key-2026-02-new
- 10:03:55 jwks endpoint contained key-2026-02-new
- 10:12:03 rollback to key-2026-02-old; validation successes resumed
```

maya (oncall): thanks everyone. leaving thread in ops-shift's hands. adding incident label `auth-signing-rotation-glitch`.

ops-shift: acknowledged. will post the postmortem draft in ~48h and tag here for review.

security-bot: Reminder: retain logs for 90 days per compliance.

pagerduty: Incident P-4491 closed at 10:20 UTC.
